title: Gemma 3n Full Release
summary: Google announced the full release of Gemma 3n on June 26, 2025, following its May preview, with downloadable model weights and support across multiple developer tools and deployment options.
significance: A dated full-release milestone for Google's mobile-first Gemma 3n family, kept distinct from the May 20 preview boundary.
